description: This file defines a static class GrainTypeGenerator used for generating grain type names based on key types in Orleans framework. It includes interface and class definitions for various grain types with different key types, a dictionary for type switching, and methods to retrieve grain type names.

classes.name: GrainTypeGenerator
classes.description: A static class providing methods to generate grain type names based on key types, with internal mappings and interface/class definitions for test grains.

methods.name: GetGrainType
methods.description: Returns the assembly qualified name of a grain type based on the generic key type parameter.

methods.name: GetGrainType
methods.description: Returns the assembly qualified name of a grain type based on the key type parameter and grain type parameter, using internal type switch logic.
